meaning:
1) to be deep, be profound, make deep
1a) (Qal) to be deep
1b) (Hiphil) to make deep, make profound
glosses: against whom you have so blatantly

renderings.bsb: against whom you have so blatantly

elsewhere.note: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
“Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.
The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I discipline all of them.
